title: Wanderburg Best Build — Early Modules and Upgrades
description: Wanderburg best build ideas for early runs: sustain modules, cannon packages, upgrade picks from demo guides, FAQ, and what we refuse to invent.

paragraphs: There is no single frozen meta yet. Demo-era guides converge on sustain first (Carpenter / Zimmermann healing), then area clear, then boss damage.
Steam’s own pitch emphasizes experimenting with wildly different builds each run — use these as starting templates, not commandments.
If you are brand new, finish a couple Demo runs and skim the Beginner Guide before copying any package below.
Open with healing / carpenter modules so you can stay in fights long enough to snowball (Bullet Haven and German tip pages agree on early sustain).
Layer cannons and explosion-proc upgrades for crowd clear. Tip articles warn that oversized firepower without mobility gets you pinned — keep drifting while turrets work.
Between runs, look for unlocks Steam groups as modules, vehicles, artifacts, and captains that reinforce artillery identity rather than random shiny options.
If you keep dying to positioning, temporarily value movement comfort and circular kiting over max damage. GameStar’s demo coverage treats castle handling as a core pleasure — it is also a skill gate.
Once you can circle a fortress without eating every projectile, re-introduce sustain and AoE clear. Builds fail more often from bad driving than from missing a legendary module name.

sections.h2: How this ties to other pages
paragraphs: Modules overview: use the Modules navigation page for cannons / towers / explosives / vehicles / captains categories from Steam.
Unlocks page: explains the between-run layer without a fake checklist of every item ID.
Captains page: documents the unlock role honestly — we do not publish a fake “best captain” DPS ladder without sourced patch data.
Tier List page: observation-only roles until multiple independent rankings exist.
What is the best build right now? There is no stable post-EA consensus on research day. Start sustain → AoE → boss damage, then adapt.
Should I use cheat / item-ID sites? No. This wiki will not recommend save editors or trainer pages even though searchers look for them.
Will EA wipe the demo meta? Very likely systems and drop pools change. Revisit this article after major patches and prefer Steam news / Discord notes over undated blogs.
We do not publish fake DPS tables, invented item IDs, or guaranteed drop rates.
After September 8, 2026 Early Access, update priorities with patch notes and fresh community tests — not nostalgia for demo-era tips.

note: Demo / pre-EA guidance. Numbers and module names may shift after Early Access patches.
